Namaskaar Dosto, aaj baat karte hain Smartphones on EMI ke baare mein. EMI affordable zaroor lagti hai, lekin kai baar yeh ek financial trap ban jaati hai. Kya expensive phone sirf EMI ki wajah se lena sahi hai? Iss video mein maine practical examples ke saath explain kiya hai ki smart financial decisions kaise lene chahiye aur unnecessary debt se kaise bachna chahiye. Chaliye Dosto, shuru karte hain!
